description.value: Bravo Cucina Ristorante Italiano is an Italian restaurant on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver, one of the city's main commercial corridors and a natural route for cyclists exploring the North Shore. The restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor seating, making it an option for cyclists who prefer to dine outside. It is a no-smoking establishment per OSM tags.
